tool.name: eDNAFlow LCA
tool.description: offline lowest-common-ancestor taxonomy assignment from BLAST results

param.name: feature_table
param.label: OTU/ZOTU/ASV count table
param.help: First header must begin with #. Feature IDs must match BLAST query IDs.

param.name: blast_results
param.label: eDNAFlow-format BLAST results
param.help: At least 21 columns; qseqid column 1, staxids 3, pident 7, qcovs 21.

param.name: taxonomy_snapshot
param.label: NCBI taxonomy snapshot
param.help: Versioned NCBI taxonomy installed by the eDNAFlow LCA taxonomy Data Manager.

param.name: taxonomy
param.label: Ranked taxonomy
param.help: NCBI rankedlineage.dmp or tabular taxid plus domain-to-species ranks.

param.name: taxonomy_nodes
param.label: NCBI nodes.dmp
param.help: Optional. Supply with rankedlineage.dmp for rank-aware handling of genus, species and infraspecific taxids. Omit for legacy/simple custom taxonomy behaviour.

param.name: identity_difference
param.label: Maximum identity difference between adjacent qualifying hits
param.help: The upstream iterative hit-filtering structure is retained; identity differences are compared numerically to three decimal places.

tool.help:
eDNAFlow LCA is a standalone offline adaptation of the LCA component from eDNAFlow.
**Taxonomy**
For routine NCBI analysis, choose an installed taxonomy snapshot. Each managed snapshot contains both ``rankedlineage.dmp`` and ``nodes.dmp`` so the current taxon's NCBI rank can be distinguished from its terminal taxon name. This makes species/genus assignment rank-aware while preserving infraspecific names as provenance in the underlying taxonomy evidence.
Choose custom taxonomy files for historical or specialist analyses. A custom ``nodes.dmp`` is optional: when supplied with NCBI ``rankedlineage.dmp`` the run is rank-aware; when omitted, legacy/simple custom taxonomy behaviour is retained.
The job does not download NCBI taxonomy. Managed references are installed by the Galaxy Data Manager and are versioned by date plus a checksum-derived snapshot ID.
**Filtering defaults**
Defaults follow eDNAFlow: query coverage 100, percent identity 97, identity difference 1. The upstream iterative adjacent-hit filtering structure is retained, with identity differences compared numerically rather than lexicographically. Cross-domain qualifying evidence is reported as unresolved rather than retaining whichever domain appears first.
